The following events occurred in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''25,800 before the Battle of Yavin'''.

==Events==
*The [[Je'daii Master]] [[Daegen Lok]] experiences a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] while exploring the Chasm with [[Hawk Ryo]], and goes mad as a result. He is exiled to [[Bogan]] until he renounces the vision that he witnessed.<ref name="DotJ 6">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]]</ref>
